segs.t: Yourteco proudly bears the “Made in France” label. This means that over 90% of the materials come from France, with the remainder sourced within the European Union. This local commitment not only supports jobs and French industries but also ensures strict control over the quality of raw materials. All acrylic fabrics and insulation materials are cut and assembled directly in the company’s own workshops.

segs.t: With more than 17 years of experience, Yourteco masters the construction of resilient circular structures. The yurts are engineered to withstand wind, snow, and rain, thanks to precise calculations and proven assembly techniques. They offer perfect waterproofing, windows and doors with protective overhangs, and optimized insulation throughout.

blocks.alt: Accommodation solutions for tourism and hospitality professionals
blocks.caption: The wooden yurt manufacturer supports numerous tourism and hospitality professionals in designing high-quality accommodation spaces

segs.t: Yourteco doesn’t limit itself to standard models. The company specialises in tailor-made yurts adapted to the specific needs of each client : whether campsites, holiday rentals, event venues, or residential homes. This includes diameter selection, openings (doors, windows, roof domes with opening systems), heating options, and the integration of water and electricity connections.

The company continuously develops its products, including yurts that meet modern thermal standards (e.g. RE 2020), self-assembly kits with training support, and practical solutions such as rain gutters designed specifically for yurts. Yourteco is a dynamic player in the field of lightweight and sustainable living.

Yourteco’s expertise extends well beyond production. The company provides comprehensive assistance from project planning and building permit support to installation guidance and responsive after-sales service. This all-round approach is particularly valued by tourism professionals embracing the yurt experience.
Yourteco offers tailored support to ensure the smooth integration of our yurts into your campsite. Wherever you are!
